priorityList: Use Warrior of Elune on cooldown.

Apply and maintain Moonfire if the target will live approximately 6 seconds.
Enter regular Lunar Eclipse (Note: Solar Eclipse is inaccessible due to Lunar Calling).
Cast Starfall to spend Astral Power, maintain Starlord, or spend Touch the Cosmos.
Cast Starfire to generate Astral Power.
Maintain Starfall uptime without overcapping Astral Power
Cast Fury of Elune on cooldown, ideally when targets will remain inside the beam for its full duration
Apply and maintain Sunfire on all targets
Apply and maintain Moonfire on all targets
Enter Lunar Eclipse by casting Starfire
Cast New Moon, Half Moon, and Full Moon on cooldown to generate Astral Power
